'''Lorvon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed on [[Carrick Station]] where he sold equipment.
